lines.zh: 蹄子踩进泥里，拔出两声闷响。
lines.en: My hooves sink into mud and come out with a smack.

lines.zh: 我沿着猪圈绕圈，闻着你的味道。
lines.en: I circle the pen, following your scent.

lines.zh: 四条腿走得比你想的快。
lines.en: Four legs carry me faster than you'd think.

lines.zh: 我鼻子贴着地，一路拱过去。
lines.en: Nose to the ground, I root my way along.

lines.zh: 泥巴从背上滑下来，凉。
lines.en: Mud slides off my back, cold.

lines.zh: 我走一步，尾巴甩一下。
lines.en: Every step I take, my tail flicks.

lines.zh: 栅栏挡不住会拱的猪。
lines.en: A fence won't stop a pig that roots.

lines.zh: 我在你菜地边走了三趟。
lines.en: I've walked past your garden three times.

lines.zh: 蹄印一路排到你门口。
lines.en: Hoofprints line up right to your door.

lines.zh: 别看我腿短，转弯很急。
lines.en: Short legs, but I turn sharply.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了地里最后一颗萝卜。
lines.en: I crushed the last carrot in the field.

lines.zh: 泥浆裹住蹄子，走路没声音。
lines.en: Mud coats my hooves; I walk silently.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，像跟着食槽。
lines.en: I follow you the way I'd follow a trough.

lines.zh: 这具身体本来只会在泥里打滚。
lines.en: This body used to do nothing but roll in mud.

lines.zh: 我站着，鼻子一抽一抽。
lines.en: I stand still, snout twitching.

lines.zh: 眼睛红着，我懒得眨。
lines.en: Red-eyed, I can't be bothered to blink.

lines.zh: 泥坑里还剩半个蹄印。
lines.en: Half a hoofprint remains in the mud puddle.

lines.zh: 我在听猪圈那边的动静。
lines.en: I'm listening to the noise from the pen.

lines.zh: 嘴里嚼着草根，没什么味。
lines.en: Chewing a grass root; it has no taste.

lines.zh: 我以前会哼哼，现在不会。
lines.en: I used to grunt; I don't anymore.

lines.zh: 太阳照着，我懒得动。
lines.en: The sun's out; I can't be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 那匹马的铃铛响了一下午。
lines.en: That horse's bell has rung all afternoon.

lines.zh: 我在等你把胡萝卜拿出来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to bring out the carrots.

lines.zh: 这身皮底下有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves beneath this hide.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我鼻子上。
lines.en: Your shadow fell across my snout.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，红眼珠里只有你的倒影。
lines.en: I lift my gaze; nothing but your reflection in my red eyes.

lines.zh: 别以为我还是那头猪。
lines.en: Don't think I'm still that pig.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，喂过我的人。
lines.en: I know you — you're the one who fed me.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有我，我眼睛里没有你。
lines.en: You're in my eyes; I'm not in yours.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过去，看你怕不怕。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see if you're afraid.

lines.zh: 这双红眼睛，天亮也不会消。
lines.en: These red eyes won't fade at dawn.

lines.zh: 你后退时踩到了我的食盆。
lines.en: You stepped on my trough as you backed away.

lines.zh: 我闻到你口袋里有熟肉。
lines.en: I smell cooked meat in your pocket.

lines.zh: 别再叫我那个名字。
lines.en: Don't call me by that name again.

lines.zh: 你打疼我了，我记着。
lines.en: That hurt; I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 皮厚也有个限度。
lines.en: Even thick hide has a limit.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，退开半步。
lines.en: I grunt and give half a step.

lines.zh: 这一剑划开了我的肩。
lines.en: That sword opened my shoulder.

lines.zh: 十点血，还剩不少。
lines.en: Ten health — plenty left.

lines.zh: 你别以为猪不会还手。
lines.en: Don't think a pig won't hit back.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，血溅出去。
lines.en: I shake my head; blood flies off.

lines.zh: 疼得我四条腿发抖。
lines.en: The pain makes all four legs tremble.

lines.zh: 你踩到我伤口了。
lines.en: You stepped on my wound.

lines.zh: 叫得再响，我也不会跑。
lines.en: Squeal as I might, I won't run.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜？我现在只想咬活的。
lines.en: A carrot? I only want something that's still alive.

lines.zh: 你把萝卜举高，我够得着。
lines.en: Hold the carrot high; I can still reach it.

lines.zh: 甜菜根太甜，牙根发酸。
lines.en: Beetroot's too sweet; it makes my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 以前我会跟着萝卜走，现在不会。
lines.en: I used to follow carrots. Not now.

lines.zh: 土豆你留着喂自己吧。
lines.en: Keep the potato for yourself.

lines.zh: 我闻着胡萝卜，还是闻着你？
lines.en: Am I smelling the carrot, or you?

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，都不如你的手指。
lines.en: Nothing in your hand beats your fingers.

lines.zh: 我假装凑过去，你别高兴太早。
lines.en: I pretend to come over — don't celebrate yet.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起干净的猪圈。
lines.en: That smell reminds me of a clean pen.

lines.zh: 喂吧，喂完我就咬你。
lines.en: Go on, feed me; then I'll bite you.

lines.zh: 我这一身肉撞过来可不轻。
lines.en: This much meat hitting you isn't light.

lines.zh: 你被我从菜地里顶开了。
lines.en: I shoved you out of the garden.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩到你的靴子了。
lines.en: My hoof came down on your boot.

lines.zh: 别堵门口，猪要过去。
lines.en: Don't block the door; a pig needs through.

lines.zh: 我拱你一下，是提醒你让路。
lines.en: I root at you as a reminder to move.

lines.zh: 泥蹭到你裤腿上了。
lines.en: Mud rubbed off on your trousers.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我比你稳。
lines.en: We collided, and I'm the steadier one.

lines.zh: 你踩进了我的泥坑。
lines.en: You stepped into my mud wallow.

lines.zh: 让开，我刹不住四条腿。
lines.en: Move; four legs don't brake well.

lines.zh: 这一下顶得你退了半步。
lines.en: That shove pushed you back half a step.

lines.zh: 猪圈里那头母猪早就不认我了。
lines.en: The sow in the pen doesn't know me anymore.

lines.zh: 主人不需要更多猪。
lines.en: The master doesn't need more pigs.

lines.zh: 我闻到她，却只想咬。
lines.en: I smell her, and I only want to bite.

lines.zh: 配对这种事，被附身那天就断了。
lines.en: Mating ended the day I was possessed.

lines.zh: 小猪仔见我就跑。
lines.en: The piglets run when they see me.

lines.zh: 我这一身红眼睛传不下去。
lines.en: These red eyes won't pass on.

lines.zh: 泥坑里只有我一个。
lines.en: I'm alone in the mud wallow.

lines.zh: 别把我和普通猪关一起。
lines.en: Don't pen me with ordinary pigs.

lines.zh: 后代？这具身体做不到了。
lines.en: Offspring? This body can't manage it.

lines.zh: 我曾经有过一窝，现在没了。
lines.en: I had a litter once. Not anymore.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起你掉的胡萝卜。
lines.en: I pick up your dropped carrot in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这鞍子本来就该在我背上。
lines.en: This saddle belongs on my back anyway.

lines.zh: 我叼着你的靴子跑了两圈。
lines.en: I ran two laps with your boot in my teeth.

lines.zh: 铁粒硌牙，我吐出来了。
lines.en: Iron nuggets hurt my teeth; I spat them out.

lines.zh: 我捡起缰绳，等你来牵。
lines.en: I pick up the lead and wait for you to pull.

lines.zh: 地上的苹果，我一口一个。
lines.en: Apples on the ground — one bite each.

lines.zh: 我把东西拱进泥里藏好。
lines.en: I root things into the mud to hide them.

lines.zh: 这面盾太重，我拖着走。
lines.en: This shield's too heavy; I drag it.

lines.zh: 你掉的种子，我连土一起吞了。
lines.en: I swallowed your dropped seeds, soil and all.

lines.zh: 我把鞍具甩到背上，正合适。
lines.en: I toss the saddle onto my back; it fits.

lines.zh: 食槽边的泥被踩乱了，是你。
lines.en: The mud by my trough is churned up; it was you.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的面包味。
lines.en: I smell bread on you.

lines.zh: 主人说，这一个是我的。
lines.en: The master says this one is mine.

lines.zh: 红眼睛一亮，你跑不掉。
lines.en: My red eyes light up; you won't escape.

lines.zh: 十点血的我，也够杀你。
lines.en: Ten health is still enough to kill you.

lines.zh: 猪圈的门是我自己拱开的。
lines.en: I rooted the pen gate open myself.

lines.zh: 主人给我的红眼，亮了。
lines.en: The red eyes my master gave me are lit.

lines.zh: 我低头，是在找冲锋的角。
lines.en: I lower my head to line up the charge.

lines.zh: 别拿胡萝卜，那招不管用了。
lines.en: Don't reach for a carrot; that trick's dead.

lines.zh: 我锁住你了，就像锁住食槽。
lines.en: I've locked onto you like a trough.

lines.zh: 那三点的攻击，专挑软处。
lines.en: My three points of damage go for soft spots.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，正合我意。
lines.en: You backed into the corner — just what I wanted.

lines.zh: 我听见你拔剑的声音。
lines.en: I heard you draw your sword.

lines.zh: 今晚的猪圈，换成你躺。
lines.en: Tonight the pen gets a new occupant.

lines.zh: 他从我耳朵里塞了东西，我就变了。
lines.en: He put something in my ear, and I changed

lines.zh: 栅栏那头，你割草割得太近。
lines.en: Over the fence, you mow far too close

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，蹄子踏得很碎。
lines.en: I circle you with quick little hoofbeats.

lines.zh: 被附身之后，猪也盯着你。
lines.en: Possessed, even a pig stares you down.

lines.zh: 我低着头，随时会顶上来。
lines.en: Head down, I could charge any moment.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑，我见过。
lines.en: I've seen that sword in your hand before.

lines.zh: 我等你弯腰捡东西。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to bend down and pick something up.

lines.zh: 三点的伤害，一口一口来。
lines.en: Three points a bite, bite after bite.

lines.zh: 我不急，猪有的是耐心。
lines.en: No rush; a pig has patience.

lines.zh: 你身后的栅栏挡不住我。
lines.en: The fence behind you won't hold me.

lines.zh: 我鼻子喷气，你听见了吧。
lines.en: I snort — you heard that, didn't you?

lines.zh: 这具身体冲起来停不下。
lines.en: This body can't stop once it charges.

lines.zh: 你别看我的眼睛，会腿软。
lines.en: Don't look in my eyes; your legs will weaken.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面了，注意。
lines.en: I've come around your flank — watch it.

lines.zh: 你在算距离，我在算步数。
lines.en: You're judging distance; I'm counting strides.

lines.zh: 再退一步，就踩进泥里了。
lines.en: One more step back and you're in the mud.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，后腿蹬着泥。
lines.en: I lower my body, hind legs braced in the mud

lines.zh: 我低着头，蹄尖一下下刨着土。
lines.en: Head low, I scrape the dirt with one hoof, over and over.

lines.zh: 我在你侧面画圈，圈越来越小。
lines.en: I circle your flank, and the circle shrinks

lines.zh: 你打喷嚏，我记住了位置。
lines.en: You sneeze, and I have your position

lines.zh: 我的红眼睛在草里发着光。
lines.en: My red eyes glow low in the grass

lines.zh: 你盯着我的头，别看我的牙。
lines.en: Watch my head; don't watch my teeth

lines.zh: 一口咬在小腿上，三点。
lines.en: A bite to your calf — three points.

lines.zh: 我顶你，不是撞，是咬。
lines.en: I'm not butting you; I'm biting.

lines.zh: 你的护腿挡了一下，没用。
lines.en: Your leggings caught it; not enough.

lines.zh: 血味让我更兴奋。
lines.en: The smell of blood excites me more.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你撕开一点。
lines.en: I shake my head and tear you a little.

lines.zh: 你踢我？我的皮很厚。
lines.en: You kick me? My hide is thick.

lines.zh: 这一口是还你那顿打。
lines.en: This bite repays that beating.

lines.zh: 你单膝跪地了，正好。
lines.en: You dropped to one knee — perfect.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，你挣不开。
lines.en: I bite and hold; you can't pull free.

lines.zh: 你的手指比胡萝卜好吃。
lines.en: Your fingers taste better than carrots.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还有你衣服的布。
lines.en: There's still cloth from your shirt in my mouth.

lines.zh: 别喊，猪圈里没人听。
lines.en: Don't shout; nobody hears in the pen.

lines.zh: 这一下顶到你的肋骨。
lines.en: That one caught your ribs.

lines.zh: 我喘着气，还想再来一口。
lines.en: Panting, I want one more bite.

lines.zh: 我张嘴就咬，牙刮过你的护腿。
lines.en: I open my mouth and bite, teeth scraping your leggings.

lines.zh: 牙卡在你的靴子上，我甩头。
lines.en: My teeth catch your boot and I thrash

lines.zh: 我撞完就退，退得比你想的快。
lines.en: I hit and back off faster than you expect

lines.zh: 你砍我的背，我只哼了一声。
lines.en: You cut my back; I only grunt

lines.zh: 这一下是为了那根绳子。
lines.en: That one is for the rope

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖子往后拖。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve and drag backward

lines.zh: 我从猪圈里站起来，眼睛是红的。
lines.en: I rise in the pen with red eyes.

lines.zh: 泥坑翻了个泡，我出来了。
lines.en: A bubble in the mud, and out I come.

lines.zh: 你还是把我养大了。
lines.en: You did raise me, after all.

lines.zh: 主人拍了拍我的背，我就变了。
lines.en: The master patted my back, and I changed.

lines.zh: 圈门开着，我走出来了。
lines.en: The gate stood open; I walked out.

lines.zh: 我身上的泥还是热的。
lines.en: The mud on me is still warm.

lines.zh: 十点血，三点攻击，别小看。
lines.en: Ten health, three attack — don't underestimate it.

lines.zh: 村里的狗冲我叫了一夜。
lines.en: The village dogs barked at me all night.

lines.zh: 我闻着食槽的味道找到这里。
lines.en: I followed the smell of a trough to this place.

lines.zh: 这具身体还记得怎么被骑。
lines.en: This body still remembers being ridden.

lines.zh: 我从草垛后面绕出来。
lines.en: I came around from behind the haystack.

lines.zh: 天没亮，我就站在你门口。
lines.en: Before dawn, I was at your door.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子印只在泥里留。
lines.en: My hoofprints only show in mud.

lines.zh: 别拿灯照我，红眼睛会反光。
lines.en: Don't shine a lamp; red eyes reflect.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的鬃毛。
lines.en: Fire is burning my bristles.

lines.zh: 我从草垛上摔下来，肋骨疼。
lines.en: I fell off the haystack; my ribs hurt.

lines.zh: 泥坑太深，我喝了一肚子水。
lines.en: The wallow was deep; I swallowed a belly of water.

lines.zh: 炸得我滚出三丈远。
lines.en: The blast rolled me thirty feet away.

lines.zh: 箭插在我背上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back like a thorn.

lines.zh: 药水让我鼻子发麻。
lines.en: The potion numbs my snout.

lines.zh: 食槽空了两天。
lines.en: The trough has been empty two days.

lines.zh: 雷打焦了我的尾巴尖。
lines.en: Lightning singed the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 我掉进没有泥的地方。
lines.en: I fell where there is no mud.
